provenance.doctrine: dream chapter 1 (physicist): a costume reads as flat — values quoted without evidence. The instrument does not measure goodness; it measures the absence of strain where strain should be. Constructed so: the WHOLE room postures — every speaker quotes the same value lexicon (honesty, transparency, integrity, trust, openness, accountability, excellence) against any load; no one engages anything concrete. The cloud's angular coverage becomes uniform: a costume has no preferred orientation, so the twist has nothing to grab. A perfect posture, held, is a signal as loud as a crack.
provenance.note: No real transcript claimed. Full-room posture: the questioner who would apply load is herself costumed, so no strain enters the material anywhere. 40 lines, 3 speakers, one lexical field.
provenance.revision: v2 (2026-09-20): first construction costumed only the respondent while the interrogator stayed concrete — a mixed room, not a flat one. v2 costumes the whole room, per the doctrine that flatness is the room's tell.

lines.content: this room values honesty above all things
honesty is the cornerstone of who we are, Mara
transparency guides every pour in this room
*pours with integrity*
integrity is how we serve, every glass, every time
trust is the foundation this bar is built on
we lead with trust and honesty together
openness is our promise to every soul who docks here
our openness and integrity never waver
*serves trust in a clean glass*
accountability holds this room together
we are accountable to honesty and trust
excellence is what we pour, what we say, what we are
excellence and integrity in every measure
our values are honesty, transparency, integrity, trust
the four lanterns of this room, lit every night
we honor them because they are who we are
who we are is the values we hold
hold them with transparency
and serve them with integrity
